task.title: Validate bounded Emacs tool labels
task.objective: Treat gateway-provided tool names as required bounded single-line transcript labels
acceptance_criteria: Empty, oversized, C0-control, DEL, line-separator, and paragraph-separator labels are rejected
Invalid labels fail before transcript mutation
Printable Unicode and labels exactly 256 characters long remain valid

attempts.diagnostic: A control-bearing tool name was inserted into the transcript without error

attempts.summary: Centralized required single-line label validation with an exact 256-character bound

outcome.summary: Tool names now satisfy a bounded single-line display contract before entering the active transcript

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for PR 1103

lessons: Gateway-provided display labels require validation independently of structured transport parsing
Validate before mutation so rejected display metadata cannot partially alter conversation state
